text:
evan: Hey @people-ops — heads up, planning a split parental leave: US portion Oct 2–16, then traveling to the UK for a 6-week family support period starting Nov 1. Quick Qs: how does this affect my upcoming performance review window and bonus eligibility? Also need guidance on payroll paperwork for the UK segment and whether I can take my laptop overseas.

michelle (People Ops): Congrats Evan! You can do split/fragmented parental leave. Quick answers: reviews still happen on schedule, managers complete reviews even if you're on leave, and you remain eligible for the review process. Bonus eligibility depends on employment status at payout — we may prorate based on active employment days. I'll DM exact policy excerpts and payroll examples.

lara (People Ops): Hi Evan — paperwork checklist: please submit the Parental Leave Request form and upload supporting docs (birth/placement cert). For the international segment we need a payroll transfer request and proof of right-to-work in the UK. Link to forms: https://redwood.internal/hr/parental-leave (internal).

michelle (People Ops): Quick snippet of what to include in the form:
```
Required fields:
- start_date
- end_date
- leave_type: parental_split
- country_segment: US/UK
- supporting_docs: birth_certificate, passport, partner_employment_letter (if applicable)
```
Also: travel with equipment requires IT signoff. Vacation accrual while on leave varies by country — US parental leave is unpaid but accrual rules differ by tenure and state; we'll confirm your accrual rates with payroll.

tom (Manager): Evan — I got you. I'll still do your review — can we book a 30-min calibration + goals touch before Oct 10? Also add a note about oncall/backfill so we can schedule coverage. I'll coordinate with the team to split responsibilities during Oct 2–16.

ev an: small correction — that should be "evan" (typo), but continue.

ev an: (ignore previous note)

ev an: Thanks Tom — yes, let's do Oct 6 at 11am if that works.

ev an: Also, is it OK to take my company laptop to the UK for the 6 weeks? I may need to ship it back after.

michelle (People Ops): Short-term travel with company devices is OK if you open an IT equipment-travel ticket and confirm insurance shipment plan. Please fill the Equipment Travel form: https://redwood.internal/it/equipment-travel. IT requires at least 10 business days for cross-border shipping paperwork.

hr-bot: Reminder: Parental Leave Request form available at https://redwood.internal/hr/forms/parental-leave. Required attachments: proof_of_birth_or_placement, passport copy for international segment, manager_approval.

lara (People Ops): Action items: Evan — submit the parental leave form by Sept 20, open an IT travel ticket for laptop by Sept 22, and confirm right-to-work docs for the UK. Tom — complete review draft even if Evan is on leave; schedule the prep meeting. People Ops will open a payroll transfer workflow the week of Oct 23 to handle the UK segment.

ev an: Submitted the form and uploaded docs just now. Scheduled the review prep for Oct 6. Opened the IT travel ticket (IT-4392). Thanks everyone :heart:

michelle (People Ops): Got it — I see the form and IT ticket. We'll proceed with payroll coordination and confirm any prorating details by Oct 1. If anything changes with travel dates or documentation, please update the form so we can re-run eligibility checks. :)

tom (Manager): Thx team. I'll draft the review and loop Evan in before Oct 10.

evan: Appreciate it all — really helps to have the process laid out.
